Field.Label: Show debug info in event log:

When ticked, the plugin never changes your UniFi Network application: firewall policies, traffic routes, port forwards, WLANs, PoE/port control, device restarts and client purge are blocked and logged instead of sent (client purge runs as a dry run). Protect, Access and Drive are not affected - cameras, RTSP streams, door unlocks, doorbells and the UNAS keep working as normal.

• Known clients are devices the controller recognizes (not guests/temporary devices) • Unknown clients (guests, one-time visitors) won't auto-create devices • Use "Create Unknown Clients" action to manually add unknown clients
